# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 9 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 9
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. For concerning the circumcision which they trusted in, he says to them: "Thus says the Lord your God" — here I find a new commandment — "Sow not among thorns; circumcise your foreskins to your Lord your God."
2. And what does he say? "Circumcise the hardness of your heart and stiffen your neck no more." Take it again: "Behold, says the Lord, all the nations are uncircumcised in their foreskin, but this people is uncircumcised in heart."
3. But you will say: the people have truly received circumcision as a seal. But every Syrian and Arab and all the priests of the idols have it — are they then of the covenant? Even the Egyptians belong to circumcision!
4. Learn abundantly therefore, children of love, about all things: Abraham, who was the first to give circumcision, performed it looking forward to Jesus in the spirit, having received the doctrines of three letters.
5. For it says: "And Abraham circumcised from his household eighteen men and three hundred." What knowledge was given to him? Notice that it says the eighteen first, and then after a space the three hundred.
6. In eighteen: I = ten, H = eight, and you have JESUS. And because the cross in the shape of T was about to have grace, it says and three hundred. So it reveals Jesus in the two letters, and in one the cross.
7. He who put the innate gift of his doctrine in us knows it. No one has learned from me a more genuine word; but I know that you are worthy.
